title: Technology Roadmap & Fractional CTO Advisory
summary: Eliminate tech paralysis with 2-week strategic scoping, stack selection, and developer-ready 90-day technical execution roadmaps.

problem.headline: Tech Paralysis & Unclear Developer Specifications
points: Non-technical founders overwhelmed by tech stack choices and cloud costs.
Hiring developers without clear specifications leading to wasted budgets and abandoned apps.
Getting overcharged by agencies due to lack of technical oversight.

approach.headline: C4 System Blueprints & Phased 90-Day Milestones
points: Audit business workflows and select modern, stable, non-hype technologies.
Draft modular technical specs, database schemas (DBML), and OpenAPI contracts.
Break execution into 30-day milestones with explicit acceptance criteria.

deliverables: Comprehensive System Architecture Blueprint (C4 Model & DB Schemas)
Technology Stack Justification & Cloud Cost Comparison Matrix
Phased 90-Day Technical Execution Roadmap with 30-day sprint milestones
Developer Hiring & Agency RFP Specification Brief

pricing.anchorText: Fixed-Fee Scoping Package or Monthly Advisory
